messages:
marcos: quick design sync: we need a lightweight autofallback "preview" flow that can't accidentally flip routing.
tina: yep. preview must be read-only by default and run a sim against a sliding 1h window. show traffic projection + confidence band.
arjun: also include a "quota-aware" flag so ops can see if fallback would blow past token limits. warn if so.
marcos: UI idea: tiny policy card with title, trigger, fallback target, traffic_cap, simulate button. clicking simulate returns cards: traffic%, cost_delta, quota_risk.
tina: simulate should surface why it triggered (e.g., 5xx spike vs p95 latency). a small explain link is helpful.
arjun: audit: every simulate-run gets an event id and is stored for 14d, sampled payloads redacted. overrides require operator id + reason + TTL.
security-bot: Reminder: overrides that affect prod pools require SSO group membership and 2FA confirmation per policy SEC-45.
marcos: good catch. add a preflight modal when applying live: cost checkbox + expected traffic change + option to schedule rollback.
tina: UX nit: when a canary is running show current canary percent and projected fallback percent side-by-side.
arjun: dev-api: POST /v1/policies/simulate with route, window, sample_size; respond w/ p10/p50/p90 projections and event_id.
marcos: ok i'll prototype card + modal and share frames. keeping the flow compact so SREs can act quickly. :+1:
